description: Get the exact amount to pay for a passage of `chars` characters (20 to 800) on a rail and asset, for example rail=base, asset=USDC. Fixed price: one US cent per character. Returns units, token, and the payout address. Does not send payment.

asset.description: Asset on that rail, e.g. USDC, ETH, SOL, BTC.

chars.description: Character count of the trimmed passage.

rail.description: Payment rail id from read_spec, e.g. base, ethereum, solana, bitcoin.

name: quote_passage
title: Quote a passage
